import sys

def count_score_values(N, T, actions):
    scores = [0]*N
    score_values = {0}
    count = 1
    for i in range(T):
        a, b = actions[i]
        new_score_values = set()
        for score in score_values:
            for j in range(b+1):
                new_score = score + j*a
                new_score_values.add(new_score)
        score_values = new_score_values
        count += len(score_values)
        print(count)

# Read input
input_lines = sys.stdin.readlines()
N, T = map(int, input_lines[0].split())
actions = [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in input_lines[1:]

count_score_values(N, T, actions)
